content: What are the cochlear A, B and height of ZETA, and which of them fall outside the published ranges?
Cochlear dimensions of ZETA, run 19ac527c · pipeline v0.1.0 · QC pass_with_warnings

For specimen **ZETA** (pipeline run 19ac527c, v0.1.0):

| Dimension | Value (mm) | Reference Range (mm) | In Range? |
|-----------|------------|----------------------|-----------|
| Cochlea A | 8.97 | 8.17 – 9.33 | ✅ Yes |
| Cochlea B | 6.81 | 5.73 – 7.50 | ✅ Yes |
| Height | 4.36 | 2.80 – 3.72 | ❌ **No** |

**Cochlear height** is the only measurement that falls outside the published reference range (Zahara2019, 36 ears, ages 2–17). All other dimensions are within their respective ranges.

The measurements use a landmark-free proxy method (oriented bounding box along the scala tympani). The QC status for this run is *pass_with_warnings*.
